items.gist: Mantras are awakened forms of reflective consciousness; entering the ācārya, they make instruments into agents.
The passage assigns seed syllables to supports, elements, tattvas, petals, and śaktis in ordered mandalas.
It distinguishes full seat-by-seat puja from abbreviated puja using selected seed syllables.
The ratiśekhara mantra's limbs and extended pervasion are described with bindu, nāda, and related principles.
Named stages culminate in mahāvyāpti, whose transformation, dissolution, and salutation are explained.
A three-syllable mantra and bhairava seat mantra are formed, with mātṛkā-mālinī mantras already stated.
Mantras for Gaṇeśa and others are given, along with universal bīja formation and aghorī-related seeds.
Mantras for devī triads, śakti pairs, and the parāparādevī vidyā are specified with syllable counts.
Remaining pivanyā material is noted, devatācakra arrangement is too extensive to write, and parā vyāpti with jīva is described.
Jīva and prāṇa are interrelated; haṃsa and six-cakra practice are presented as increasingly luminous.
Prāṇa in seated posture, one-syllable supreme knowledge, and parā hṛdaya for paired ritual are explained.
Other one-syllable mantras are hidden and fruitful for kulastha practitioners through subtle knowledge.
Practice applies to women or men; oṃkāra-based mantras form vidyā aṅga hṛdaya and brahmaśiras.
Armor, eye, and weapon mantras are given with their syllables and general applicability.
Weapon mantras for deities are formed with long and short vowels; six jātis correspond to six ritual acts.
Namaskāra-derived jātis and the mātṛ sadman mantra are described, along with a luminous jīva.
All beings are animated by this mantra; supreme sadbhāva of mātṛs and Bhairava is praised.
The mantra accomplishes all siddhis; daṇḍa, jīva, triśūla, and yoginī-cakra lordship are identified.
Mahācaṇḍā and the more secret kālarātri kṣurikā are described, with head pain from repetition.
One should meditate on mṛtyujit and not recite kṣurikā for long life; the chedinī astra is visualized blazing from feet to head.
